decision.reasoning_trace: I selected the Google Pixel Watch as the final choice because it has a high rating of 4.3, a large number of reviews (1116), and it offers advanced features such as heart rate tracking, GPS, and LTE connectivity. The consideration set includes a mix of high-end and affordable options, with a focus on watches that offer a range of health and fitness features. The Apple Watch Series 6 and the Polar Vantage V2 were not included in the final choice because they are more expensive and may not be suitable for all customers. The LFUTARI and mingwear smartwatches were included in the consideration set because they offer advanced features at a lower price point.
